name: brand-film
description: Make a narrated, on-brand explainer film (MP4, poster, captions) from a deck, a document, a web page or a story: HTML scenes rendered frame by frame, ElevenLabs narration or a person's recorded voice checked by speech-to-text, licensed footage, synthesized or generated sound effects and an optional score; as 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 with burned-in captions and cut-downs.
